name: Junior Volunteer Program
org: Sharp Chula Vista Medical Center Auxiliary (Sharp HealthCare)
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital for at least one year, with one 2 to 4 hour shift a week.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 through 11, at least 14 years old, who have finished 8th grade and have a GPA of 3.0 or higher. Seniors are pointed to the college or adult program after graduation.
duration: Minimum 1 year, 2 to 4 hour shift once a week
deadline_text: The 2026 window ran Oct 1 to Nov 12, 2026 and has ended. For that round, teacher evaluations come in by Dec 11, 2026 and results go out by email Jan 31, 2027. The next window is likely next fall; no dates are posted yet.
how_to_apply: Use the 'High school volunteers (junior volunteers)' online application during the next window. A follow-up email asks for your transcript and parental consent, then teacher referrals, an interview and orientation.
notes: Many teens apply, so it is hard to get in. Getting set up can take up to three months. If you are picked, you need shots and tests: MMR, chickenpox, Tdap, COVID, flu and TB. Contact scv.volunteers@sharp.com or 619-502-3606.
